facts.quote: Graza started Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) but also made sure to get into grocers like Whole Foods, Target, etc.

parsed.subject: Collaborative Instagram Post Proposal
parsed.body:
Hi Graza team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to crafting authentic and playful experiences for food lovers. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you and Graza, built on the fact that Graza started Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) but also made sure to get into grocers like Whole Foods, Target, etc. You’ve cultivated a social content strategy that’s delightfully unconventional, featuring playful messaging and culinary-inspired imagery.  Specifically, Graza’s social content, product design, and messaging are designed to be engaging and memorable, rather than overly formal.  Dickieson estimated that Graza has added around 2,000 new social followers since launching the cans.  We envision a collaborative post where you share a visually striking image of a new can, accompanied by a short, evocative caption that captures the essence of the product and the brand’s playful approach.  Together, we could create a post that subtly reinforces the unique character of Graza and invites followers to engage with the brand’s storytelling.  We’d love to hear your thoughts on this idea.

The BrandPilot team
